verses.text: For the choir director; [set to] Al-tashheth. A Psalm of Asaph, a Song. We give thanks to You, O God, we give thanks, For Your name is near; Men declare Your wondrous works.
verses.textZh: （亞薩的詩歌，交與伶長。調用休要毀壞。）神啊，我們稱謝你，我們稱謝你！因為你的名相近，人都述說你奇妙的作為。

verses.text: 'When I select an appointed time, It is I who judge with equity.
verses.textZh: 我到了所定的日期，必按正直施行審判。

verses.text: 'The earth and all who dwell in it melt; It is I who have firmly set its pillars. Selah.
verses.textZh: 地和其上的居民都消化了；我曾立了地的柱子。（細拉）

verses.text: 'I said to the boastful, 'Do not boast,' And to the wicked, 'Do not lift up the horn;
verses.textZh: 我對狂傲人說：不要行事狂傲！對凶惡人說：不要舉角！

verses.text: Do not lift up your horn on high, Do not speak with insolent pride.''
verses.textZh: 不要把你們的角高舉；不要挺著頸項說話。

verses.text: For not from the east, nor from the west, Nor from the desert [comes] exaltation;
verses.textZh: 因為高舉非從東，非從西，也非從南而來。

verses.text: But God is the Judge; He puts down one and exalts another.
verses.textZh: 惟有神斷定；他使這人降卑，使那人升高。

verses.text: For a cup is in the hand of the LORD, and the wine foams; It is well mixed, and He pours out of this; Surely all the wicked of the earth must drain [and] drink down its dregs.
verses.textZh: 耶和華手裡有杯，其中的酒起沫，杯內滿了攙雜的酒；他倒出來，地上的惡人必都喝這酒的渣滓，而且喝盡。

verses.text: But as for me, I will declare [it] forever; I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.
verses.textZh: 但我要宣揚，直到永遠！我要歌頌雅各的神！

verses.text: And all the horns of the wicked He will cut off, [But] the horns of the righteous will be lifted up.
verses.textZh: 惡人一切的角，我要砍斷；惟有義人的角必被高舉。
